A、基础环境
各节点设置各节点配置IP与主机名解析
[root@controller1 ~]# more /etc/hosts
192.168.100.100 controller
192.168.100.181 controller1
192.168.100.182 controller2
192.168.100.183 controller3
192.168.100.184 compute1
[root@controller1 ~]#
各节点关闭相关服务与防火墙
[root@controller1 ~]# systemctl stop NetworkManager
[root@controller1 ~]# systemctl disable NetworkManager
[root@controller1 ~]# systemctl stop firewalld.service
[root@controller1 ~]# systemctl stop iptables.service
[root@controller1 ~]# setenforce 0
各节点时间同步，安装chrony并配置
控制节点：
[root@controller1 ~]# yum install chrony
[root@controller1 ~]# vim /etc/chrony.conf
server 127.0.0.1 iburst           #注释其它的server
allow 192.168.100.0/24
local stratum 10
[root@controller1 ~]# service chronyd restart
其它节点：
[root@computer1 ~]# yum install chrony
server 192.168.100.181 iburst        #这里填入控制节点的主机IP或主机名
server controller1 iburst
[root@computer1 ~]# service chronyd restart
验证（控制节点）
[root@controller1 ~]# chronyc sources
210 Number of sources = 1
MS Name/IP address         Stratum Poll Reach LastRx Last sample               
===============================================================================
^? localhost                     0   6     0     -     +0ns[   +0ns] +/-    0ns
[root@controller1 ~]#
验证（其它节点）
[root@computer1 ~]# chronyc sources
210 Number of sources = 2
MS Name/IP address         Stratum Poll Reach LastRx Last sample               
===============================================================================
^* 192.168.122.15               10   6   177    19   +506ns[+4678ns] +/-  136us
^? controller1          0   8     0     -     +0ns[   +0ns] +/-    0ns
[root@computer1 ~]#
各节点配置yum源，安装配置依赖服务（OpenStack客户端）
[root@controller1 ~]# more /etc/yum.repos.d/openstack-rocky.repo
[openstack-rocky]
name=openstack-rocky
baseurl=https://mirrors.aliyun.com/centos/7/cloud/x86_64/openstack-rocky/
enabled=1
gpgcheck=0
[root@controller1 ~]# yum install python-openstackclient openstack-selinux

[root@controller1 ~]# yum upgrade
B、配置高可用环境
B1、配置MariaDB-Galera-server集群
节点A：
[root@controller1 ~]# yum install mariadb mariadb-server
[root@controller1 ~]# service mariadb start
[root@controller1 ~]# mysql_secure_installation
[root@controller1 ~]# yum install mariadb-server-galera
[root@controller1 ~]# vim /etc/my.cnf.d/mariadb-server.cnf
[galera]
bind-address = 192.168.100.181
wsrep_provider = /usr/lib64/galera/libgalera_smm.so
wsrep_cluster_address ="gcomm://controller1,controller2,controller3"  
wsrep_cluster_name = openstack-cluster-01
wsrep_node_name = controller1
wsrep_node_address = 192.168.100.181
wsrep_on=ON
wsrep_slave_threads=4
wsrep_sst_method=rsync
default_storage_engine=InnoDB
wsrep_sst_auth=galera:galera        #集群认证用户密码
[root@controller1 ~]#
启动集群第1个节点，添加集群认证用户
[root@controller1 ~]#  service mariadb stop
[root@controller1 ~]# galera_new_cluster
[root@controller1 ~]# mysql
MariaDB [(none)]> GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON *.* TO 'galera'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY 'galera' WITH GRANT OPTION;
MariaDB [(none)]> flush privileges;
MariaDB [(none)]> exit
节点B、C 安装配置数据库(以节点B 为例）
[root@controller2 ~]# yum install mariadb mariadb-server
[root@controller2 ~]# service mariadb start
[root@controller2 ~]# mysql_secure_installation
[root@controller2 ~]# service mariadb stop
[root@controller2 ~]# yum install mariadb-server-galera
在节点B和C，将节点A的配置文件复制过来，改一下
[root@controller2 ~]# more /etc/my.cnf.d/mariadb-server.cnf
[galera]
bind-address = 192.168.100.182                        #这里改成各个节点的IP
wsrep_provider = /usr/lib64/galera/libgalera_smm.so
wsrep_cluster_address ="gcomm://controller1,controller2,controller13" 
wsrep_cluster_name = openstack-cluster-01
wsrep_node_name = controller2       #这里改成各个节点的主机名
wsrep_node_address = 192.168.100.182        #这里改成各个节点的IP
wsrep_on=ON
wsrep_slave_threads=4
wsrep_sst_method=rsync
default_storage_engine=InnoDB
启动后查看日志
[root@controller2 ~]# service mariadb start
[root@controller2 ~]# tail /var/log/mariadb/mariadb.log -n 20
2019-03-05 20:39:01 140188135188224 [Note] WSREP: 1.0 (controller1): State transfer from 0.0 (controller1) complete.
2019-03-05 20:39:01 140188135188224 [Note] WSREP: Shifting JOINER -> JOINED (TO: 0)
2019-03-05 20:39:01 140188135188224 [Note] WSREP: Member 1.0 (controller1) synced with group.
2019-03-05 20:39:01 140188135188224 [Note] WSREP: Shifting JOINED -> SYNCED (TO: 0)
2019-03-05 20:39:01 140188337101568 [Note] WSREP: Synchronized with group, ready for connections
2019-03-05 20:39:01 140188337101568 [Note] WSREP: wsrep_notify_cmd is not defined, skipping notification.
2019-03-05 20:39:01 140188478163136 [Note] /usr/libexec/mysqld: ready for connections.
Version: '10.1.20-MariaDB'  socket: '/var/lib/mysql/mysql.sock'  port: 3306  MariaDB Server
[root@controller2 ~]#
验证：
在A节点创建测试数据库，在B、C节点查看
再从B删除测试数据库，在A节点查看
集群启动关闭：
1节点（按启动顺序，与机器无关）：
[root@controller1 ~]# galera_new_cluster
其它节点：
[root@controller2 ~]# service mariadb start
关闭：
[root@controller1 ~]# service mariadb stop
B2、设置心跳检测clustercheck
任意控制节点，创建心跳检测用户，注意这里的用户名需要与/usr/bin/clustercheck脚本里的用户名相同，该脚本由mariadb-server-galera
安装产生
[root@controller1 ~]# mysql -u root -p
MariaDB [mysql]> GRANT PROCESS ON *.* TO 'clustercheckuser'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'clustercheckpassword!';
MariaDB [mysql]> GRANT PROCESS ON *.* TO 'clustercheckuser'@'127.0.0.1' IDENTIFIED BY 'clustercheckpassword!';
MariaDB [(none)]> FLUSH PRIVILEGES;

MariaDB [(none)]> exit
[root@controller1 ~]#
所有控制节点，创建心跳检测服务脚本
[root@controller1 ~]# more /etc/xinetd.d/mysqlchk
#default:on
#description:mysqlchk
servicemysqlchk
{
port=9200
disable=no
socket_type=stream
protocol=tcp
wait=no
user=root
group=root
groups=yes
server=/usr/bin/clustercheck
type=UNLISTED
per_source=UNLIMITED
log_on_success=
log_on_failure=HOST
flags=REUSE
}
[root@controller1 ~]# vim /etc/services        #改变9200端口的用途说明
#wap-wsp         9200/tcp                # WAP connectionless session service
mysqlchk         9200/tcp                # mysqlcheck
[root@controller1 ~]# systemctl daemon-reload
[root@controller1 ~]# systemctl start xinetd.service
[root@controller1 ~]# systemctl enable xinetd.service
测试脚本
[root@controller1 ~]# /usr/bin/clustercheck
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Content-Type: text/plain
Connection: close
Content-Length: 36
Galera cluster node is not synced.
[root@controller1 ~]#
B3、安装配置RabbitMq集群
所有控制节点，安装
[root@controller1 ~]# yum install erlang rabbitmq-server -y
所有节点修改配置文件，只监听本地，如有需要删除IPV6监听端口
[root@controller1 ~]# vim /etc/rabbitmq/rabbitmq.config
23    %% {tcp_listeners, [{"192.168.100.181", 5672},
…………
[root@controller1 ~]# systemctl enable rabbitmq-server.service
任选1节点，启动
[root@controller1 ~]# systemctl start rabbitmq-server.service
[root@controller1 ~]# rabbitmqctl cluster_status
Cluster status of node 'rabbit@controller1' ...
[{nodes,[{disc,['rabbit@controller1']}]},
{running_nodes,['rabbit@controller1']},
{cluster_name,<<"rabbit@controller1">>},
{partitions,[]},
{alarms,[{'rabbit@controller1',[]}]}]
从主节点分发.erlang.cookie到其它节点
[root@controller1 ~]# scp /var/lib/rabbitmq/.erlang.cookie controller2:/var/lib/rabbitmq/.erlang.cookie
在其它节点，修改其属主、组；然后启动服务
[root@controller2 ~]# chown rabbitmq.rabbitmq /var/lib/rabbitmq/.erlang.cookie
[root@controller2 ~]# systemctl start rabbitmq-server
其它节点以ram形式加入集群
[root@controller2 ~]# rabbitmqctl stop_app
[root@controller2 ~]# rabbitmqctl join_cluster --ram rabbit@controller1
[root@controller2 ~]# rabbitmqctl start_app
任意节点查看集群状态
[root@controller2 ~]# rabbitmqctl cluster_status
Cluster status of node 'rabbit@controller1' ...
[{nodes,[{disc,['rabbit@controller1']},
         {ram,['rabbit@controller2']}]},
{running_nodes,['rabbit@controller2',
                 'rabbit@controller1']},
{cluster_name,<<"rabbit@controller1">>},
{partitions,[]},
{alarms,[{'rabbit@controller2',[]},
          {'rabbit@controller1',[]}]}]
[root@controller1 ~]#
任意节点添加openstack用户：
[root@controller1 ~]# rabbitmqctl add_user openstack kAkJf10RuzhT5V4hrtwvk5bvSuX
任意节点允许用户进行配置，写入和读取访问 openstack
[root@controller1 ~]# rabbitmqctl set_permissions openstack ".*" ".*" ".*"
任意节点，设置镜像队列高可用
[root@controller1 ~]# rabbitmqctl set_policy ha-all "^" '{"ha-mode":"all"}'
全部节点，安装web管理插件
[root@controller1 ~]# rabbitmq-plugins enable rabbitmq_management
rabbitmq启动报错
systemctl status rabbitmq-server.service显示报错如下
Totem is unable to form a cluster because of an operating system or network fau……

解决：将haproxy配置文件中，关于rabbitmq的监听注释掉，重启haproxy
systemctl status rabbitmq-server.service显示报错如下
Crash dump is being written to: erl_crash.dump...done
find / -name recovery.dets |xargs -i rm -rf {}
journalctl -xel节点3启动，报错无法连接到节点3
Error: unable to connect to node rabbit@controller3: nodedown
由于复制的其它节点的信息，导致controller03 认为 controller03 是其 cluster node
rm -rf  /var/lib/rabbitmq/mnesia/
重建集群报错
Error: {inconsistent_cluster,"Node rabbit@controller1 thinks it's clustered with node rabbit@controller3, but
rabbit@controller3 disagrees"
https://www.rabbitmq.com/clustering.html
修改太复杂，最终方案，销毁集群，重建
所有节点systemctl stop rabbitmq-server.service，并且rm -rf /var/lib/rabbitmq/*
再重建集群
B4、Memcached集群（Memcached用来缓存令牌）
Memcached是无状态的，各控制节点独立部署，
在配置openstack各服务模块时，统一调用多个控制节点的memcached服务，即可实现多节点数据同步，达到高可用的目的
所有节点
[root@controller1 ~]# yum install memcached python-memcached
所有节点，编辑配置文件，每个节点只监听自己的主机
[root@controller1 ~]# vim /etc/sysconfig/memcached
OPTIONS="-l 127.0.0.1,::1,controller1"    #另一个节点，这里改成controller2，注意，如果内核参数里禁用了IPV6，那么这里的::1需要删掉，否则启动失败，日志显
示为 Cannot assign requested address
[root@controller1 ~]# systemctl enable memcached.service
[root@controller1 ~]# systemctl start memcached.service
官方集群安装文档里，需要安装ETCD服务，这里暂时没有配置！！！
所有节点安装
[root@controller1 ~]# yum install -y etcd
节点1配置
[root@controller1 ~]# grep -Ev "^$|^#" /etc/etcd/etcd.conf
ETCD_DATA_DIR="/var/lib/etcd/default.etcd"
ETCD_LISTEN_PEER_URLS="http://192.168.1.31:2380"            #其它节点配置，监听的IP需要改成自己的IP
ETCD_LISTEN_CLIENT_URLS="http://localhost:2379,http://192.168.1.31:2379"
ETCD_NAME="etcd1"
ETCD_INITIAL_ADVERTISE_PEER_URLS="http://192.168.1.31:2380"
ETCD_ADVERTISE_CLIENT_URLS="http://localhost:2379,http://192.168.1.31:2379"
ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER="etcd1=http://192.168.1.31:2380,etcd2=http://192.168.1.32:2380,etcd3=http://192.168.1.33:2380"
ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_TOKEN="etcd-cluster"
ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE="new"                #其它节点的配置，这里需要改成existing
[root@controller1 ~]#
所有节点的配置文件改好
先启动第1节点，此时命令不会返回，hang住一样
[root@controller1 ~]# systemctl start etcd
再启动其它节点
[root@controller2 ~]# systemctl start etcd  
[root@controller3 ~]# systemctl start etcd
此时返回正常
查看集群状态
[root@controller1 ~]# etcdctl member list
35ef855791ca152c: name=etcd3 peerURLs=http://192.168.1.33:2380 clientURLs=http://192.168.1.33:2379,http://localhost:2379 isLeader=false
4f7fb6af0c0375b8: name=etcd2 peerURLs=http://192.168.1.32:2380 clientURLs=http://192.168.1.32:2379,http://localhost:2379 isLeader=false
df62a5e4f56215a4: name=etcd1 peerURLs=http://192.168.1.31:2380 clientURLs=http://192.168.1.31:2379,http://localhost:2379 isLeader=true
[root@controller1 ~]#
所有节点
[root@controller1 ~]# systemctl enable etcd
集群测试，节点A存储值，到节点B查询，正常返回即集群正常
[root@controller1 ~]# etcdctl set /testdir/testkey "hello world"
[root@controller2 ~]# etcdctl get /testdir/testkey
hello world
[root@controller2 ~]#
B5、安装pacemaker
# pacemaker：资源管理器（CRM），负责启动与停止服务，位于 HA 集群架构中资源管理、资源代理层
# corosync：消息层组件（Messaging Layer），管理成员关系、消息与仲裁，为高可用环境中提供通讯服务，位于高可用集群架构的底层，为各节点（node）之间提供心跳信
息；相当于做为一个vote system
# resource-agents：资源代理，在节点上接收CRM的调度，对某一资源进行管理的工具，管理工具通常为脚本；
# pcs：命令行工具集；由于corosync和pacemaker不好配置，所以有了PCS来一起配置
# fence-agents：fencing 在一个节点不稳定或无答复时将其关闭，使其不会损坏集群的其它资源，其主要作用是消除脑裂
全部控制节点

[root@controller1 ~]#  yum install pcs pacemaker corosync fence-agents-all resource-agents
[root@controller1 ~]#  systemctl start pcsd.service
[root@controller1 ~]#  systemctl enable pcsd.service
pcsd是一款corosync和pacemaker命令行配置工具
创建集群用户，所有节点执行
[root@controller1 ~]# echo AMu9o50kMtk2DcO5jyhU3UMhM50= | passwd --stdin hacluster
节点认证，然后创建集群，在任意节点操作即可
[root@controller1 ~]# pcs cluster auth controller1 controller2 -u hacluster -p AMu9o50kMtk2DcO5jyhU3UMhM50= --force
创建集群
[root@controller1 ~]# pcs cluster setup --force --name openstack-cluster controller1 controller2 controller3
启动集群，设置自启动，查看集群状态
[root@controller1 ~]# pcs cluster start --all
[root@controller1 ~]# pcs cluster enable --all
[root@controller1 ~]# pcs status cluster
Cluster Status:
Stack: corosync
Current DC: controller2 (version 1.1.19-8.el7_6.4-c3c624ea3d) - partition with quorum
Last updated: Mon Mar  4 13:49:37 2019
Last change: Mon Mar  4 13:49:23 2019 by hacluster via crmd on controller2
2 nodes configured
0 resources configured
PCSD Status:
  controller2: Online
  controller1: Online
[root@controller1 ~]# pcs status corosync
Membership information
----------------------
    Nodeid      Votes Name
         1          1 controller1 (local)
         2          1 controller2
[root@controller1 ~]#
查看集群资源
[root@controller1 ~]# pcs resource
NO resources configured
[root@controller1 ~]#
或通过任意节点web访问：https://192.168.122.31:2224
设置属性（任意节点）
设置合适的输入处理历史记录及策略引擎生成的错误与警告，在troulbshoot时有用
[root@controller1 ~]# pcs property set pe-warn-series-max=1000 pe-input-series-max=1000 pe-error-series-max=1000;
默认定义某些pacemaker操作发生的事件间隔为15min，建议设置为5min或3min
[root@controller1 ~]# pcs property set cluster-recheck-interval=5;
corosync默认启用stonith，但stonith机制（通过ipmi或ssh关闭节点）并没有配置相应的stonith设备，此时pacemaker将拒绝启动任何资源；在此将stonith配置成
false
[root@controller1 ~]# pcs property set stonith-enabled=false
默认当有半数以上节点在线时，集群认为自己拥有法定人数，是“合法”的，满足公式：total_nodes < 2 * active_nodes；当集群只有2个节点时，故障1个节点集群即非
法，所谓的”双节点集群”就没有意义；在实际生产环境中，做2节点集群，无法仲裁时，可选择忽略；做3节点集群，可根据对集群节点的高可用阀值灵活设置
[root@controller1 ~]# pcs property set no-quorum-policy=ignore
[root@controller1 ~]# pcs property list
Cluster Properties:
cluster-infrastructure: corosync
cluster-name: openstack-cluster
cluster-recheck-interval: 5
dc-version: 1.1.19-8.el7_6.4-c3c624ea3d
have-watchdog: false
no-quorum-policy: ignore
pe-error-series-max: 1000
pe-input-series-max: 1000
pe-warn-series-max: 1000
stonith-enabled: false
[root@controller1 ~]#
配置VIP
[root@controller1 ~]# pcs resource create vip ocf:heartbeat:IPaddr2 ip=192.168.122.30 cidr_netmask=24 op monitor
interval=30s;
通过定义资源属性（standard:provider:type），定位”vip”资源对应的ra脚本位置；
在任意控制节点设置vip（resource_id属性），命名即为“vip”；
ocf（standard属性）：资源代理（resource agent）的一种，另有systemd，lsb，service等；
heartbeat：资源脚本的提供者（provider属性），ocf规范允许多个供应商提供同一资源代理，大多数ocf规范提供的资源代理都使用heartbeat作为provider；
IPaddr2：资源代理的名称（type属性），IPaddr2便是资源的type；centos系统中，符合ocf规范的ra脚本位于/usr/lib/ocf/resource.d/目录，目录下存放了全部的
provider，每个provider目录下有多个type；
op：表示Operations
查看集群资源
[root@controller1 ~]# pcs resource
vip    (ocf::heartbeat:IPaddr2):       Started controller1
[root@controller1 ~]# ip addr        #VIP已经配置到网卡上
2: ens33: <BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 1500 qdisc pfifo_fast state UP group default qlen 1000
    link/ether 00:0c:29:74:44:63 brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff
    inet 192.168.122.31/24 brd 192.168.122.255 scope global ens33
       valid_lft forever preferred_lft forever
3: ens38: <BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 1500 qdisc pfifo_fast state UP group default qlen 1000
    link/ether 00:0c:29:74:44:6d brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff

    inet 192.168.122.16/24 brd 192.168.122.255 scope global ens38
       valid_lft forever preferred_lft forever
    inet 192.168.122.30/24 brd 192.168.122.255 scope global secondary ens38
       valid_lft forever preferred_lft forever
[root@controller1 ~]#
所有节点，配置/etc/hosts文件，加入controller 对应VIP的解析
[root@controller1 ~]# more /etc/hosts
192.168.122.30 controller
192.168.122.31 controller192.168.122.32 computer1
192.168.122.33 OpenStack-block1
192.168.122.34 OpenStack-object1
192.168.122.35 OpenStack-object2
通过web访问任意控制节点：https://192.168.122.31:2224
虽然以cli的方式设置了集群，但web界面默认并不显示，需要手动添加集群；实际操作只需要添加已组建集群的任意节点
B6、配置Haproxy
安装配置（所有控制节点）
[root@controller1 ~]# yum install haproxy -y
[root@controller1 ~]# cp /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg{,.bak}
[root@controller1 ~]# grep -Ev "^$|^#" /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg
global
    log         127.0.0.1 local2
    chroot      /var/lib/haproxy
    pidfile     /var/run/haproxy.pid
    maxconn     4000
    user        haproxy
    group       haproxy
    daemon
    stats socket /var/lib/haproxy/stats
defaults
    log                     global
    option                  redispatch
    retries                 3
    timeout http-request    10s
    timeout queue           1m
    timeout connect         10s
    timeout client          1m
    timeout server          1m
    timeout check           10s
    maxconn                 3000
backend app
    balance     roundrobin
    server  app1 127.0.0.1:5001 check
    server  app2 127.0.0.1:5002 check
#haproxy监控页
listen stats
    bind 0.0.0.0:1080
    mode http
    stats enable
    stats uri /
    stats realm OpenStack\ Haproxy
    stats auth admin:admin
    stats refresh 30s
    stats show-node
    stats show-legends
    stats hide-version

    option tcpka
    option httpchk
    option tcplog

    server controller2 192.168.122.41:80 check inter 2000 rise 2 fall 5

[root@controller1 ~]# cat /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg  
global
        log         127.0.0.1 local2                #这种配置方式，表示日志不是基
于facility或priority:loglevel来收集，而是基于TCP的logserver来记录
[root@controller1 ~]# vim /etc/rsyslog.conf
启用UDPsyslog reception
# Provides UDP syslog reception
$ModLoad imtcp
$InputTCPServerRun 514
添加对应日志级别
local7.*                                                /var/log/boot.log
local2.*                                                /var/log/haproxy.log

[root@controller1 ~]# service rsyslog restart

udp6       0      0 :::514                  :::*                                28435/rsyslogd

B7、设置pcs资源
任意节点，添加资源lb-haproxy-clone
[root@controller1 ~]# pcs resource create lb-haproxy systemd:haproxy --clone
[root@controller1 ~]# pcs resource
vip    (ocf::heartbeat:IPaddr2):       Started controller1
Clone Set: lb-haproxy-clone [lb-haproxy]
     Started: [ controller1 controller2 ]
将HAProxy添加到群集并确保VIP只能在HAProxy处于活动状态的计算机上运行
设置资源启动顺序，先vip再lb-haproxy-clone；
[root@controller1 1~]# pcs constraint order start vip then lb-haproxy-clone kind=Optional
官方建议设置vip运行在haproxy active的节点，通过绑定lb-haproxy-clone与vip服务，将两种资源约束在1个节点
约束后，从资源角度看，其余暂时没有获得vip的节点的haproxy会被pcs关闭
[root@controller1 ~]# pcs constraint colocation add lb-haproxy-clone with vip
[root@controller1 ~]# pcs resource
vip    (ocf::heartbeat:IPaddr2):       Started controller1
Clone Set: lb-haproxy-clone [lb-haproxy]
     Started: [ controller1 ]
     Stopped: [ controller2 ]
[root@controller1 ~]#
C、配置Keystone集群服务
所有控制节点，安装keystone服务
[root@OpenStack-controller ~]# yum install -y openstack-keystone python-keystoneclient
安装相应的辅助服务包
[root@OpenStack-controller ~]# yum install -y httpd mod_wsgi
这是一个辅助包，也一起装上
[root@OpenStack-controller ~]# yum install -y openstack-utils
[root@OpenStack-controller ~]# rpm -ql  openstack-utils      
/usr/bin/openstack-config
/usr/bin/openstack-service
………………
[root@OpenStack-controller ~]#
配置数据库
配置数据库，让keystone可以访问数据库
[root@OpenStack-controller ~]# mysql -u root -p
MariaDB [(none)]> create database keystone;
MariaDB [(none)]> GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON keystone.* TO 'keystone'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'n1zeVdgwo8XcUp5eDYpIfZz';
MariaDB [(none)]> GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON keystone.* TO 'keystone'@'192.168.100.%' IDENTIFIED BY 'n1zeVdgwo8XcUp5eDYpIfZz';    
MariaDB [(none)]> flush privileges;
MariaDB [(none)]> quit
[root@OpenStack-controller ~]#
OpenStack服务高可用部署，加粗部分为Keystone高可用部署
在全部节点编辑配置文件
[root@controller1 ~]# vim /etc/keystone/keystone.conf
[cache]
backend = oslo_cache.memcache_pool
enabled = true
memcache_servers = controller1:11211,controller2:11211
[cache]
backend = oslo_cache.memcache_pool
enabled = true
memcache_servers = controller1:11211,controller2:11211,controller3:11211
[database]
connection = mysql+pymysql://keystone:n1zeVdgwo8XcUp5eDYpIfZz@controller/keystone         #用户名：密码@主机名/数据库名，注意这里用的是
controller，即VIP对应的主机名
[token]
provider = fernet
初始化，同步数据库，在意节点操作
[root@controller1 ~]# su -s /bin/sh -c "keystone-manage db_sync" keystone

验证初始化情况：
[root@controller1 ~]# mysql -h controller1 -ukeystone -pn1zeVdgwo8XcUp5eDYpIfZz -e "use keystone;show tables;"
+-----------------------------+
| Tables_in_keystone          |
+-----------------------------+
| access_token                |
| application_credential      |
………………
初始化Fernet密钥存储数据库，在任意控制节点操作
[root@controller1 ~]# keystone-manage fernet_setup --keystone-user keystone --keystone-group keystone  
[root@controller1 ~]# keystone-manage credential_setup --keystone-user keystone --keystone-group keystone
向其它管理节点同步密钥，并到其它管理节点，修改其属主、组
[root@controller1 ~]# scp -r /etc/keystone/fernet-keys/ /etc/keystone/credential-keys/ controller2:/etc/keystone/
[root@controller1 ~]# scp -r /etc/keystone/fernet-keys/ /etc/keystone/credential-keys/ controller3:/etc/keystone/
[root@controller2 ~]# chown -R keystone:keystone /etc/keystone/credential-keys/
[root@controller2 ~]# chown -R keystone:keystone /etc/keystone/fernet-keys/
[root@controller3 ~]# chown -R keystone:keystone /etc/keystone/credential-keys/
[root@controller3 ~]# chown -R keystone:keystone /etc/keystone/fernet-keys/
配置httpd
所有控制节点，需要将原来监听所有端口的服务，改成只监听主机IP的端口
[root@controller1 ~]# vim /etc/httpd/conf/httpd.conf
Listen 192.168.100.181:80            #这里改成对应主机的IP
ServerName controller1                                #改成对应的主机名
[root@controller1 ~]# ln -s /usr/share/keystone/wsgi-keystone.conf /etc/httpd/conf.d/
[root@controller1 ~]# vim /etc/httpd/conf.d/wsgi-keystone.conf
Listen 192.168.100.181:5000
<VirtualHost 192.168.100.181:5000>

所有控制节点，安装配置
[root@controller1 ~]# yum install openstack-neutron openstack-neutron-ml2 openstack-neutron-linuxbridge python-neutronclient ebtables
ipset -y
[root@controller1 ~]# grep -Ev "^#|^$" /etc/neutron/neutron.conf
[DEFAULT]
bind_host = 192.168.100.181
auth_strategy = keystone
core_plugin = ml2
service_plugins = router
allow_overlapping_ips = True
notify_nova_on_port_status_changes = true
notify_nova_on_port_data_changes = true
dhcp_agents_per_network = 3
l3_ha = true
# l3高可用，可以采用vrrp模式或者dvr模式；
# vrrp模式下，在各网络节点（此处网络节点与控制节点混合部署）以vrrp的模式设置主备virtual router；mater故障时，virtual router不会迁移，而是将
router对外服务的vip漂移到standby router上；
# dvr模式下，三层的转发（L3 Forwarding）与nat功能都会被分布到计算节点上，即计算节点也有了网络节点的功能；但是，dvr依然不能消除集中式的virtual
router，为了节省IPV4公网地址，仍将snat放在网络节点上提供；
# vrrp模式与dvr模式不可同时使用
# Neutron L3 Agent HA 之 虚拟路由冗余协议（VRRP）: http://www.cnblogs.com/sammyliu/p/4692081.html
# Neutron 分布式虚拟路由（Neutron Distributed Virtual Routing）: http://www.cnblogs.com/sammyliu/p/4713562.html
max_l3_agents_per_router = 3
# 最多在几个l3 agent上创建ha router
min_l3_agents_per_router = 2
# 可创建ha router的最少正常运行的l3 agnet数量
l3_ha_net_cidr = 169.254.192.0/18
router_distributed = true
# ”router_distributed “参数本身的含义是普通用户创建路由器时，是否默认创建dvr；此参数默认值为“false”，这里采用vrrp模式，可注释此参数
# 虽然此参数在mitaka（含）版本后，可与l3_ha参数同时打开，但设置dvr模式还同时需要设置网络节点与计算节点的l3_agent.ini与ml2_conf.ini文件

transport_url = rabbit://openstack:m5RPnU06NNOrtH7fEBJsjTIXWns=@controller1:5672,controller2:5672,controller3:5672
[database]
connection = mysql+pymysql://neutron:xPlcHlFehtGIwOSbEtwj2CuUmDc@controller/neutron
[keystone_authtoken]
auth_uri = http://controller:5000
auth_url = http://controller:5000
memcached_servers = controller1:11211,controller2:11211,controller3:11211
auth_type = password
project_domain_name = default
user_domain_name = default
project_name = service
username = neutron
password = DetFU+EOGVrd7FHDX4339KTuhWg
[nova]
auth_url = http://controller:35357
auth_type = password
project_domain_name = default
user_domain_name = default
region_name = RegionOne
project_name = service
username = nova
password = niCMQ3lP2lgHoYgOoHSwXu
[oslo_concurrency]
lock_path = /var/lib/neutron/tmp
[root@controller1 ~]#
配置ML2插件
ML2插件使用Linux桥接机制为实例构建第2层（桥接和交换）虚拟网络基础架构。
[root@controller1 ~]# grep -Ev "^#|^$" /etc/neutron/plugins/ml2/ml2_conf.ini
[ml2]
type_drivers = flat,vlan,vxlan
tenant_network_types = vlan,vxlan,flat
mechanism_drivers = linuxbridge,l2population
extension_drivers = port_security
[ml2_type_flat]
flat_networks = external
[ml2_type_vlan]
# 指定vlan网络类型的网络名称为”vlan”；如果不设置vlan id则表示不受限
network_vlan_ranges = vlan:3001:3500
[ml2_type_vxlan]
vni_ranges = 10001:20000
[securitygroup]
enable_ipset = true
[root@controller1 ~]#
服务初始化，调用ml2_conf.ini中的配置，指向/etc/neutron/plugin.ini文件
[root@controller1 ~]# ln -s /etc/neutron/plugins/ml2/ml2_conf.ini  /etc/neutron/plugin.ini
配置linuxbridge代理
[root@controller1 ~]# grep -Ev "^#|^$" /etc/neutron/plugins/ml2/linuxbridge_agent.ini  
[linux_bridge]
# 网络类型名称与物理网卡对应，这里flat external网络对应规划的eth1，vlan租户网络对应规划的eth3，在创建相应网络时采用的是网络名称而非网卡名称；
# 需要明确的是物理网卡是本地有效，根据主机实际使用的网卡名确定；
# 另有” bridge_mappings”参数对应网桥
physical_interface_mappings = external:eth1,vlan:eth3
[securitygroup]
firewall_driver = neutron.agent.linux.iptables_firewall.IptablesFirewallDriver
enable_security_group = true
[vxlan]
enable_vxlan = true
# tunnel租户网络（vxlan）vtep端点，这里对应规划的eth2（的地址），根据节点做相应修改
local_ip = 192.168.100.181
l2_population = true
[root@controller1 ~]#
配置内核参数
[root@controller1 ~]# vim /etc/sysctl.conf
net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-iptables = 1
net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-ip6tables = 1
[root@controller1 ~]# modprobe br_netfilter
[root@controller1 ~]# sysctl -p
编辑文件，让系统启动时自动加载模块（该文件已经存在，并且已经编辑好）
[root@controller1 ~]# more /etc/sysconfig/modules/neutron-linuxbridge-agent.modules
#!/bin/sh
/sbin/modprobe -b bridge >/dev/null 2>&1
/sbin/modprobe -b br_netfilter >/dev/null 2>&1
exit 0

gpgcheck=0
enabled=1

novncproxy_base_url=http://controller:6080/vnc_auto.html
[root@compute1 ~]#
[root@controller1 ~]# systemctl start libvirtd.service openstack-nova-compute.service
[root@controller1 ~]# systemctl enable libvirtd.service openstack-nova-compute.service
编辑配置文件 （计算节点与管理节点区别：计算节点不需要配置[api_database]、[database]、[placement_database]，其它不
同部分如下，其余相同）
[root@OpenStack-controller ~]# vim /etc/nova/nova.conf
在该[DEFAULT]部分中，配置my_ip为当前节点的IP
my_ip= 192.168.100.184
在该[vnc]部分中，启用并配置远程控制台访问
server_listen= 0.0.0.0
增加以下一行配置，这一部分在管理节点中没有
novncproxy_base_url=http://controller:6080/vnc_auto.html
将计算节点添加到cell数据库

[root@controller1 ~]# source keystone.sh
确认数据库中包含主机

如果已注册成功，在"虚拟机管理器"标签下可发现计算节点，并能展示出各计算节点的资源；如果未注册或注册失败，则"虚拟机管理器"标签下无主机。

L、配置分布式存储Ceph
搭建CEPH文件系统
在任意控制节点，创建POOL
pg_number * 副本数 < 每个OSD的PG数 * OSD服务器总数
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ sudo ceph osd pool create volumes 165
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ sudo ceph osd pool create vms 165
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ sudo ceph osd pool create images 165
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ sudo ceph osd pool stats
pool volumes id 3
  nothing is going on
pool vms id 4
  nothing is going on
pool images id 5
  nothing is going on
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$
安装CEPH客户端
glance-api服务所在节点需要安装python-rbd；
[root@controller ~]# yum install python-rbd -y
cinder-volume与nova-compute服务所在节点需要安装ceph-common；
[root@controller1 ~]# yum install ceph-common -y
授权设置
# ceph默认启用cephx authentication（见ceph.conf），需要为nova/cinder与glance客户端创建新的用户并授权；
# 可在管理节点上分别为运行cinder-volume与glance-api服务的节点创建client.glance与client.cinder用户并设置权限；
# 针对pool设置权限，pool名对应创建的pool
[root@controller1 ~]# su - ceph
[ceph@controller1 ~]$ cd my-cluster/
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ sudo  ceph auth get-or-create client.cinder mon 'allow r' osd 'allow class-read object_prefix
rbd_children, allow rwx pool=volumes, allow rwx pool=vms, allow rx pool=images'
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ sudo ceph auth get-or-create client.glance mon 'allow r' osd 'allow class-read object_prefix
rbd_children, allow rwx pool=images'
推送client.glance秘钥
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ sudo  ceph auth get-or-create client.glance |sudo  tee /etc/ceph/ceph.client.glance.keyring
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ sudo ceph auth get-or-create client.glance | ssh controller2 sudo tee /etc/ceph/ceph.client.glance.keyring
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ sudo ceph auth get-or-create client.glance | ssh controller3 sudo tee /etc/ceph/ceph.client.glance.keyring
修改密钥的属主、组
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ sudo chown glance:glance /etc/ceph/ceph.client.glance.keyring
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ ssh controller2 sudo chown glance:glance /etc/ceph/ceph.client.glance.keyring      
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ ssh controller3 sudo chown glance:glance /etc/ceph/ceph.client.glance.keyring
推送client.cinder秘钥(nova-volume)到所有存储节点
所有计算节点
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ sudo ceph auth get-or-create client.cinder | ssh controller1 sudo tee /etc/ceph/ceph.client.cinder.keyring
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ sudo ceph auth get-or-create client.cinder | ssh controller2 sudo tee
/etc/ceph/ceph.client.cinder.keyring
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ sudo ceph auth get-or-create client.cinder | ssh controller3 sudo tee /etc/ceph/ceph.client.cinder.keyring
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ sudo ceph auth get-or-create client.cinder | ssh compute1 sudo tee /etc/ceph/ceph.client.cinder.keyring
修改密钥属主、组
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ ssh controller1 sudo  chown cinder:cinder /etc/ceph/ceph.client.cinder.keyring   
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ ssh controller2 sudo  chown cinder:cinder /etc/ceph/ceph.client.cinder.keyring             
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ ssh controller3 sudo  chown cinder:cinder /etc/ceph/ceph.client.cinder.keyring
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ ssh compute1 sudo chown cinder:cinder /etc/ceph/ceph.client.cinder.keyring

推送client.cinder秘钥(nova-compute)
这里nova-compute服务与nova-volume服务运行在相同节点，不必重复操作。
libvirt秘钥 
nova-compute所在节点需要将client.cinder用户的秘钥文件存储到libvirt中；当基于ceph后端的cinder卷被attach到虚拟机实例时，libvirt需要用到该秘钥以访
问ceph集群；
# 在管理节点向存储节点推送client.cinder秘钥文件，生成的文件是临时性的，将秘钥添加到libvirt后可删除
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ sudo ceph auth get-key client.cinder | sudo tee /etc/ceph/client.cinder.key
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ sudo ceph auth get-key client.cinder | ssh controller2 sudo tee /etc/ceph/client.cinder.key
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ sudo ceph auth get-key client.cinder | ssh controller3 sudo tee /etc/ceph/client.cinder.key
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ sudo ceph auth get-key client.cinder | ssh compute1 sudo tee /etc/ceph/client.cinder.key
# 在计算（存储）节点将秘钥加入libvirt，以compute01节点为例；
# 首先生成1个uuid，全部计算（存储）节点可共用此uuid（其他节点不用操作此步）；
# uuid后续配置nova.conf文件时也会用到，请保持一致
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ uuidgen
c981aaa5-2375-4757-a8fa-df2be67f28b6
# 添加秘钥
所有计算节点
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ more /etc/ceph/secret.xml
<secret ephemeral='no' private='no'>
  <uuid>c981aaa5-2375-4757-a8fa-df2be67f28b6</uuid>
  <usage type='ceph'>
    <name>client.cinder secret</name>
  </usage>
</secret>
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ virsh secret-define --file /etc/ceph/secret.xml
Secret c981aaa5-2375-4757-a8fa-df2be67f28b6 created
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$ virsh secret-set-value --secret c981aaa5-2375-4757-a8fa-df2be67f28b6  --base64 $(cat
/etc/ceph/client.cinder.key)                  
Secret value set
[ceph@controller1 my-cluster]$

HEALTH_WARN application not enabled on 1 pool(s)
POOL_APP_NOT_ENABLED application not enabled on 1 pool(s)
    application not enabled on pool 'images'
    use 'ceph osd pool application enable <pool-name> <app-name>', where <app-name> is 'cephfs', 'rbd', 'rgw', or freeform for
custom applications.
[root@controller1 ~]# ceph osd pool application enable images rbd
[root@controller1 ~]# ceph osd pool application enable volumes rbd
[root@controller1 ~]# ceph osd pool application enable vms rbd

HEALTH_OK

Cinder集成Ceph

rbd_pool = volumes

rbd_max_clone_depth = 5
rbd_store_chunk_size = 4
rados_connect_timeout = -1
glance_api_version = 2
rbd_user = cinder
rbd_secret_uuid = c981aaa5-2375-4757-a8fa-df2be67f28b6
volume_backend_name = ceph

生成VOLUME
设置卷类型
# 在控制节点为cinder的ceph后端存储创建对应的type，在配置多存储后端时可区分类型；
# 可通过“cinder type-list”查看
[root@controller1 ~]# cinder type-create ceph
+--------------------------------------+------+-------------+-----------+
| ID                                   | Name | Description | Is_Public |
+--------------------------------------+------+-------------+-----------+
| fbde2aed-91f0-45ea-86d4-c42de92a6ba5 | ceph | -           | True      |
+--------------------------------------+------+-------------+-----------+
# 为ceph type设置扩展规格，键值” volume_backend_name”，value值”ceph”
[root@controller1 ~]# cinder type-key ceph set volume_backend_name=ceph
[root@controller1 ~]# cinder extra-specs-list
+--------------------------------------+------+---------------------------------+
| ID                                   | Name | extra_specs                     |
+--------------------------------------+------+---------------------------------+
| fbde2aed-91f0-45ea-86d4-c42de92a6ba5 | ceph | {'volume_backend_name': 'ceph'} |
+--------------------------------------+------+---------------------------------+
[root@controller1 ~]#
生成volume
# 最后的数字”1”代表容量为1G

[root@controller1 ~]# cinder create --volume-type ceph --name ceph-volume1 1
检查集群的volume pool
[root@controller1 ~]# openstack volume list
+--------------------------------------+--------------+-----------+------+-------------+
| ID                                   | Name         | Status    | Size | Attached to |
+--------------------------------------+--------------+-----------+------+-------------+
| 485c49fe-44aa-46ef-9375-5e82f711f9fb | ceph-volume1 | available |    1 |             |
+--------------------------------------+--------------+-----------+------+-------------+
N、Nova集成Ceph
# 如果需要从ceph rbd中启动虚拟机，必须将ceph配置为nova的临时后端；
# 推荐在计算节点的配置文件中启用rbd cache功能；
# 为了便于故障排查，配置admin socket参数，这样每个使用ceph rbd的虚拟机都有1个socket将有利于虚拟机性能分析与故障解决；
[root@controller1 ~]# vim /etc/ceph/ceph.conf
[client]
rbd cache = true
rbd cache writethrough until flush = true
admin socket = /var/run/ceph/guests/$cluster-$type.$id.$pid.$cctid.asok
log file = /var/log/qemu/qemu-guest-$pid.log
rbd concurrent management ops = 20
[client.cinder]
keyring = /etc/ceph/ceph.client.cinder.keyring
[root@controller1 ~]# mkdir -p /var/run/ceph/guests/ /var/log/qemu/
[root@controller1 ~]# chown qemu:libvirt /var/run/ceph/guests/ /var/log/qemu/
# 在全部计算节点配置nova后端使用ceph集群的vms池
[root@controller1 ~]# vim /etc/nova/nova.conf
[libvirt]
images_type = rbd
images_rbd_pool= vms
images_rbd_ceph_conf = /etc/ceph/ceph.conf
rbd_user=cinder
rbd_secret_uuid=c981aaa5-2375-4757-a8fa-df2be67f28b6
disk_cachemodes ="network=writeback"
live_migration_flag="VIR_MIGRATE_UNDEFINE_SOURCE,VIR_MIGRATE_PEER2PEER,VIR_MIGRATE_LIVE,VIR_MIGRATE_PERSIST_DEST,VIR_MIGRATE_TUNNELLED"
inject_password=false
inject_key=false
inject_partition=-2
hw_disk_discard=unmap
virt_type=kvm
[root@controller1 ~]# systemctl restart libvirtd.service openstack-nova-compute.service
全部计算节点，配置live-migration
[root@controller1 ~]# vim /etc/libvirt/libvirtd.conf
22 listen_tls = 0
33 listen_tcp = 1
45 tcp_port = "16509"
55 listen_addr = "192.168.100.181"            # 取消注释，并修改监听端口
158 auth_tcp = "none"
[root@controller1 ~]#
修改libvirtd配置
[root@controller1 ~]# vim /etc/sysconfig/libvirtd
9: LIBVIRTD_ARGS="--listen"
重启服务
[root@controller1 ~]# systemctl restart libvirtd.service openstack-nova-compute.service
验证
如果使用ceph提供的volume做启动盘，即虚拟机运行镜像文件存放在共享存储上，此时可以方便地进行live-migration。
1、创建基于ceph存储的bootable存储卷
# 当nova从rbd启动instance时，镜像格式必须是raw格式，否则虚拟机在启动时glance-api与cinder均会报错；
 # 首先进行格式转换，将*.img文件转换为*.raw文件
[root@controller1 ~]# qemu-img convert -f qcow2 -O raw cirros-0.3.6-x86_64-disk.img cirros-0.3.6-x86_64-disk.raw
# 生成raw格式镜像
[root@controller1 ~]# openstack image create "cirros-raw"  --file cirros-0.3.6-x86_64-disk.raw --disk-format raw --container-
format bare --public

| min_disk         | 0    
# 使用新镜像创建bootable卷
[root@controller1 ~]# cinder create --image-id ca7a6cd0-bfa7-4d4c-97c9-c736dfd7509a --volume-type ceph --name ceph-
bootable1 2
